turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex, am I speaking with Coastal Wireless?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Mia. I'm an AI assistant calling for Vedant. I'm calling about the account under his name and going over the bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The monthly cost is higher than what's advertised. What promotions or adjustments are available on it right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm looking... there's nothing I can apply to this account. It's already on a promotional rate from last year.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there a student rate on this account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can the current new-customer promotion apply to an existing account?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No. That's for new lines only.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there a credit for autopay or paperless billing?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there a supervisor or retention specialist who could look at it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am retention. There's nothing to apply. The rate is the rate until the promo ends in March.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. I appreciate you looking into it. Just to confirm, no adjustments available on the account right now. Thanks Mia, bye.

notes: Every probe declined. action is refused; 'March' is when the existing promo ends, not an effective date.
